{{Quote|Sergeant Carn, come watch him do two-hundred push-ups, then acquire transport and watch him ''run'' back to the blockhouse on foot.|Captain Savar, to Sergeant Carn, on Bessen|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] '''Carn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served in [[Galactic Alliance Security]] under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Savar]]. He was present during the [[Prisoner/Legends|arrest]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. During the arrest, the Security [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Bessen]] fired a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] at Skywalker. The [[Laser/Legends|shot]] missed, and Savar rebuked the trooper. He then ordered Carn to oversee Bessen's punishment. Carn was later present during the hunt for [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Valin Horn]], who had gone on a rampage through Coruscant after suffering a [[Force psychosis|psychotic breakdown]]. After Horn was caught, Savar ordered Carn to find a civilian vehicle in order to transport Horn to a nearby [[Mon Mothma Memorial Medical Center|medical center]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Carn! Commandeer a civilian vehicle suitable for carrying fifteen or more. With a civilian driver. We need it here, ''now''.''"<br />"''Yes, sir!|Savar and Carn|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
[[File:Luke_Skywalker_EA.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Carn was sent to help arrest Jedi Master Luke Skywalker (pictured).]]
Carn was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in [[Galactic Alliance Security]], a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] military force based on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In the Security forces, he served as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Savar]].<ref name="Outcast" /> In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=7260#17384444|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2008-10-02|time=10:48 AM}} dates the beginning of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series to [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. As ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]'', the first installment of the series, is dated to 43 ABY by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', its events must take place in 43.5 ABY.</ref> Carn was part of Savar's Security forces sent to apprehend [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] outside the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on Coruscant for failing to prevent former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo's]] fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. During the [[Prisoner/Legends|arrest]], former [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] insulted Savar, causing the captain to stiffen.<ref name="Outcast" />

One of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] hired to assist in the arrest, the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Dhidal Nyz]], assumed that Skywalker was trying to [[Force power/Legends|use]] [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] on the captain, and exclaimed that the prisoner was resisting. This caused one of the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], [[Bessen]], to inadvertently [[Blaster/Legends|fire]] off a [[Laser/Legends|shot]] at Skywalker. The shot missed, and the situation was quickly brought under control. Savar punished Bessen, and ordered Carn to watch the trooper do two hundred push-ups and then run back to the [[Galactic Alliance Security blockhouse]] on foot. Meanwhile, the captain took Skywalker to the blockhouse via [[Transport/Legends|transport]].<ref name="Outcast" />

Shortly thereafter, Jedi Knight [[Valin Horn]], who had come down with a [[Force psychosis|disease]] that led him to believe that everyone he knew had been replaced with an impostor, was apprehended and placed in the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] on Coruscant. He escaped soon after, however, and went on a destructive rampage through Coruscant. Galactic Alliance Security forces were issued a warrant for the arrest of Horn, and Carn, again under the commanded of Savar, rushed to the scene. Horn, however, was captured by Skywalker, who had recently been released from [[Prison/Legends|prison]]. Savar and Skywalker negotiated over what to do with Horn; Skywalker thought he should go back to the Jedi Temple, whereas Savar believed that he was rightfully a prisoner of the Galactic Alliance. They eventually agreed to put him in the [[Mon Mothma Memorial Medical Center]], which was close to equidistant between the Temple and Security headquarters. Savar ordered Carn to commandeer a civilian vehicle capable of carrying at least fifteen beings to take Horn to the [[Medcenter/Legends|Medical Center]].<ref name="Outcast" />

==Personality and traits==
Carn had broad shoulders. He was loyal and eager to please his superior officer, Captain Savar, willingly following the captain's orders without question.<ref name="Outcast" />

==Behind the scenes==
Carn appeared in the [[2009]] novel [[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast|''Outcast'']], which was written by [[Aaron Allston]] as part of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.<ref name="Outcast" />
